landing.tagline: A digital ID in a second
landing.title: Card services in one place
landing.promise: Apply from home, follow your request step by step, and get your card at your door.

apply.title: Apply
apply.text: Fill in your details and upload documents with your camera.

review.title: Review
review.text: Staff review your request and you get a notification for every change.

issue.title: Get issued
issue.text: After approval your digital card is issued with a QR code.

delivered.title: Delivered
delivered.text: An agent brings the card and you receive it with a delivery code.

catalog.title: Services
catalog.subtitle: Pick a service and apply online
catalog.emptyText: Try another category or change the search.
